LCL có lẽ khá đơn giản đối với bất kỳ ai.en: LCL is probably quite simple for anyone in the transportation industry. But for new people to participate in this or those who do not know. The following article will help you to understand more about LCL and its related terms.
LCL có lẽ khá đơn giản đối với bất kỳ ai.zh: LCL可能对运输业的任何人来说都很简单. 但新人参此或不知者. 以下文章将帮助您进一步了解LCL及其相关条款.

LCL là hình thức vận chuyển hàng hóa dàn.en: The LCL is the form of freight for non-contained goods owners for a certain container size that has to be in line with other units to be adequate.
LCL là hình thức vận chuyển hàng hóa dàn.zh: LCL是非约束性货物所有人对一定集装箱尺寸的运费形式,必须与其他单位一致才能达到适量.

Người gom hàng là người có trách nhiệm t.en: The packager is responsible on behalf of the receiver associated with the customer: The freight route report and exporting the home bill to the customer.
Người gom hàng là người có trách nhiệm t.zh: 包装者代表与客户有关的接收者负责: 货运路线报告 并出口 家庭账单给客户。

Người gửi có trách nhiệm đóng gói hàng h.en: The sender is responsible for packing and shipping to the container carrier's shipping station, doing customs transport procedures for the shipment to send, other procedures such as sterilization and labeling must also be carried out. At the same time, the sender must provide the deliveryman with the billing data to form a single and confirm the vote, receiving the single.
Người gửi có trách nhiệm đóng gói hàng h.zh: 发货人负责包装和发货到集装箱承运人的货运站,办理发货的海关运输手续,还必须办理消毒和标签等其他手续. 同时,发件人必须向送货人提供计费数据,以形成单曲并确认投票结果,接收单曲.

Người nhận hàng phải xuất trình đầy đủ g.en: The receiver must present the full amount of papers required to receive the package: bill, pine. But the difference is that the recipient doesn't need to pay the container bill, because the recipient's nature doesn't borrow the container. But on the contrary, the handling charges cost.
Người nhận hàng phải xuất trình đầy đủ g.zh: 接收者必须提交接收包裹所需的全部文件:账单,松. 但区别在于收货人不需要支付集装箱账单,因为收货人的本质并不借用集装箱. 但恰恰相反,手续费是昂贵的。

Người vận chuyển gửi lại hóa đơn cho ngư.en: The delivery man returned the bill to the sender to verify the information then export the application and the manifest. Get the container from the sender and line up on the ship, preparing the proper container for the docking ship's safety. Upon arriving at the pick-up site, the container was taken out of the ship to the receiver. Prior to delivery, the D/O must be made when receiving and checking information on the receiver's application.
Người vận chuyển gửi lại hóa đơn cho ngư.zh: 送货人将账单退回发件人核实信息,然后出口申请和清单。 将集装箱从发件人那里接过来,排到船上,为停靠船舶的安全准备适当的集装箱. 到达拾货场后,集装箱被带出船去接收. 交货前,必须在接收和检查接收器申请信息时进行D/O.

Theo nghĩa đơn giản hơn, LCL là một lô h.en: In a simpler sense, LCL is a shipment and needs to be incorporated with many other villages from different customers to a large shipment that is consistent with container capacity.
Theo nghĩa đơn giản hơn, LCL là một lô h.zh: 从更简单的意义上说,LCL是一种货物,需要与许多其他村庄合并,从不同的客户到符合集装箱容量的大型货物。

Trong lĩnh vực vận tải hàng hóa, LCL là.en: In the field of freight, the LCL is abbreviation of the word Les than Container Loading, in English meaning that the amount of cargo is not sufficient to be set up as a container.
Trong lĩnh vực vận tải hàng hóa, LCL là.zh: 在货运领域,LCL是"Les"一词的缩写而非"Contain Loding"(集装箱装载),英语意为货物数量不足以被设置为集装箱.

Vận chuyển FCL và LCL là hai phương thức.en: FCL and LCL transports are the two most popular transportation methods developed today with the aim of helping owners to save unnecessary birth and backup costs. The main difference between these two methods lies in the mass of freight that the sender can fill with container
Vận chuyển FCL và LCL là hai phương thức.zh: FCL和LCL运输是当今最流行的两种运输方法,目的是帮助车主节省不必要的分娩和备用费用. 这两种方法的主要区别在于发货人可以装满集装箱的货运量。

Với phương thức FCL, bên giao hàng và bê.en: With the FCL method, the delivery and the receiver will be responsible for packing and unloading goods. The FCL priority over the LCL line is not to wait, gather, or ship through many other transport units. This will help the export process and through the faster inspection, as well as reduce transportation costs.
Với phương thức FCL, bên giao hàng và bê.zh: 采用FCL法,交货和接收机将负责货物包装和卸货。 FCL优于LCL线路的优先权是不能等待,集合,或通过许多其他运输单位进行运输. 这将有助于出口进程和加快检查,并降低运输成本。

có nghĩa là hàng vừa đủ cho một containe.en: Which means the package fits enough for a specialized shipping container. These containers will be loaded and stamped, then incorporated transport to the final location.
có nghĩa là hàng vừa đủ cho một containe.zh: 也就是说包裹足够适合专用的集装箱 这些集装箱将加载和盖章,然后装船运往最后地点。

thường xuyên xuất hiện cùng nhau khi nói.en: often appear together when it comes to freight. Thus, many people are confused about the concept of these two terms. But these two terms are completely different in terms and usage. While LCL means not enough goods, FCL stands for Full Container Load.
thường xuyên xuất hiện cùng nhau khi nói.zh: 在货运方面经常一起出现。 因此,许多人对这两个术语的概念感到困惑. 但这两个术语在术语和用法上是完全不同的. 虽然LCL意味着货物不足,但FCL代表满载集装箱。

Để làm rõ về LCL, chúng ta có ví dụ sau:.en: To clarify LCL, we have the following example: When a client A wants to transport a number of electronic products, the equivalent of 10 cubic meters of cargo and this shipment is not enough to fill a container. The mass of the container was 35 cubic metres, at the time the order of A was paired with the order of others to fill the container. Accepting the shipment benefits both A and Transporter.
Để làm rõ về LCL, chúng ta có ví dụ sau:.zh: 为了澄清LCL,我们有以下例子: 当客户A想要运输多件电子产品时,相当于10立方米的货物和这批货物不足以装满集装箱. 容器的重量为35立方米,当时A级的顺序与其他人的顺序相配来填充容器. 接受装运对A和运输商都有好处。
